traversal.input_code:
local m=emu.memType.nesInternalRam
local st=emu.read(0x300,m)
local sc=emu.read(0x60,m)+256*emu.read(0x61,m)
local wx=emu.read(0x4e0,m)+(frame>300 and sc or 0)
if not mode then mode=0;at=0 end
local keys={right=frame>=20,a=frame>=80 and frame%90<30,b=frame>=80 and frame%90>=10 and frame%90<55 and frame%8<3}
if mode==0 and wx>=280 and st<2 then mode=1;at=frame end
if mode==1 then
 local g=frame-at
 local f=g
 keys={up=f>=3 and f<95,b=f>=3 and f<95 and f%12<3,a=f>=140 and f<175,right=f>=150}
 if f>230 then mode=2;at=frame end
elseif mode==2 then
 local y=emu.read(0x4f0,m)
 local function tile(x,yy)
  local xx=x%512;local yy=yy%240
  return emu.read(0x2000+math.floor(xx/256)*0x400+math.floor(yy/8)*32+math.floor(xx%256/8),emu.memType.nesPpuMemory)
 end
 local function solid(t)return (t>=0x2e and t<=0x33)or(t>=0x47 and t<=0x4a)end
 local ahead=tile(wx+16,y+1)
 local wall=tile(wx+12,y-12)
 if not jumpAt then jumpAt=-100; spellAt=-1000; spellPhase=0; prepared=false; prepAt=-1 end
 keys={right=true}
 if st<2 and frame-jumpAt>42 and (not solid(ahead)or solid(wall)) then jumpAt=frame end
 keys.a=frame-jumpAt<30
 local age=frame-jumpAt
 keys.b=(age>=4 and age<50 and age%12>=4 and age%12<7)or(age>55 and st<2 and solid(ahead)and not solid(wall)and frame%60<3)
 local lava=false
 for yy=40,208,16 do local t=tile(wx+48,yy);if t>=0x89 and t<=0x8e then lava=true end end
 if spellPhase==0 and lava and emu.read(0x3f05,emu.memType.nesPpuMemory)~=0x12 and emu.read(0x490,m)>=10 and st<2 then spellPhase=1;spellAt=frame end
 if spellPhase==1 then
  local f=frame-spellAt
  keys={select=(f<4)or(f>=115 and f<119),b=f>=10 and f<14}
  if f>=125 then spellPhase=0 end
 end

 if not prepared and wx>=390 and wx<416 and st<2 and prepAt<0 then prepAt=frame end
 if prepAt>=0 and not prepared then
  local f=frame-prepAt
  keys={a=f<180 and f%90<30,b=f<180 and f%90>=4 and f%90<50 and f%12>=4 and f%12<7}
  if f>=180+40 then prepared=true;jumpAt=-100 end
 end

end
emu.setInput(keys,0)
